rapport_notes: Competent and clear but fairly transactional in tone through the packing-decision back-and-forth.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "Do you have any special instructions, concerns or stresser... about this move?" - asked after address, furniture, packing, and boxes were already covered.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A - customer answered "Nothing that I can think of, honestly."
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "The shorter the move, the lower the cost at the end of the day."

coaching_note: The agenda question landed too late to shape the discovery - moving it before the logistics intake would let the rep tailor the whole call instead of bolting it on at the end.
